meta.name: writing-fragments
meta.description: Writing, explore — mine raw fragments, no structure yet.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 挖掘并整理零散的写作素材
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头有零散想法需要梳理成写作素材
copy.tagline_en: Mine and organize raw writing fragments
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have scattered ideas to turn into writing material

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会不断追问你想写什么，把对话中出现的任何好句子、想法、比喻等碎片收集到一个 Markdown 文件中，不整理结构。
howto.when: 当你开始谈论一个写作主题，或者要求探索写作素材时触发。

say.text: 我想写一篇关于远程办公的文章，帮我收集一些碎片。
say.note: Claude 会开始追问并记录你的想法。

say.text: 我有个关于“数字游民”的比喻，帮我记下来。
say.note: Claude 会把你的比喻作为碎片追加到文件中。

say.text: 把刚才那个关于孤独的句子改得更尖锐一些。
say.note: Claude 会直接编辑那个碎片。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude relentlessly interviews you about what you want to write, collecting any sharp sentences, ideas, metaphors, etc. into a single Markdown file without imposing structure.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you start discussing a writing topic or ask to explore writing material.

say_en.text: I want to write an article about remote work, help me collect fragments.
say_en.note: Claude will start questioning and recording your thoughts.

say_en.text: I have a metaphor about 'digital nomads', save it.
say_en.note: Claude will append your metaphor as a fragment.
Claude will edit that fragment in place.
